scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @engineo/contracts build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && pnpm typecheck:e2e
scripts.check:ts: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:ts && pnpm run test:security && pnpm run build
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked
scripts.check: pnpm run check:ts && pnpm run check:rust
